{{Quote|The Empire found out about us. They sent thugs to sabotage--forget the details. We've got hundreds of lab animals loose down there!|Doctor [[Rassan]]|<ref name="TOR:LA">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Lab Animals|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
'''Xenobi''' was a group affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the war, the Empire sent Xenobi to attack and sabotage the [[ChemFlex Labs|labs]] of the Republic-allied company [[ChemFlex]]. However, the Xenobi thugs released biotoxins that ChemFlex was studying, and they were infected along with the lab animals. The infected were wiped out by Republic forces in order to prevent the spread of the viruses.<ref name="TOR:LA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xenobi appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Cut dialogue strings identified Xenobi as a biotech company rival to ChemFlex.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=other|doctor_rassan}}</ref>
